spans.s: ? dhyuṣita, adj., ep. of garments or cloth, acc. to pw blendend weiss: cīvarāni (so) ˚tāni Kv 〔78.22〕; ˚ta-paṭam 〔81.7〕, see s.v. indra-paṭa. There is a very dubious record of a Skt. n. pr. Dhyuṣitāśva, BR, but this is prob. incorrect. The word paṭa is often preceded in comp. by duṣya- or dūṣya-, designating a very fine cloth, and I am inclined to read this; the text of Kv is so corrupt that it seems not implausible.
